name: Brume
author: Erin Carter
description: Moonlit mist streams sideways through a dark colonnade: near-black vertical columns silhouetted against a luminous FBM fog that glows brightest in the gaps, each window framing a slightly different drifting colour.

params.label: Pillar spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between column centres; close makes a dense paling with thin slots of light, wide leaves broad windows of glowing mist.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Horizontal speed of the streaming fog, from a hanging haze that only roils in place to a steady river of mist.

params.label: Mist glow
params.effect: Brightness of the fog behind the columns, from faint breath to bright moonlit vapor.
